notes.title: 2025 update coming soon
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players:

Today is the last day of 2024. All members of HexGameStudio wish you all good luck and good health in 2025!

The agreed three-month deadline for fixing bugs has expired, and today we uploaded the last updated version to fix bugs. Next, we will add more content, starting with voice acting. Your support is very important to us! Thank you for your love of our game.

HexGameStudio

notes.title: Introducing New Suppliers to Enhance Your Fantasy Shop!
notes.notes:
In the real world, running a supermarket involves establishing partnerships with various suppliers, affecting crucial aspects such as product availability and cost control. Building effective supply chain relationships is at the core of supermarket management.

And in our game, we have a cast of suppliers too: Nina, who manages a weapons shop, Leila, the alchemy workshop owner, the traveling merchant Eugene, and a few other occasional suppliers. Each supplier offers different types of goods, which are gradually unlocked as you progress in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43701875/7b89ed0549145a2ecf103df258fd4f384ed27c0e.png[/img]
"What treasures has Master Jin brought to you?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43701875/fc283f7b7cdabd8e3e10d892af3f13d130f2a717.png[/img]

notes.title: The Game's Management System is Undergoing Reform
notes.notes:
Recently, there have been intense discussions within our studio about the future direction of the game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43701875/81cdc4040867a551e8b2aa5b416df13f0d514521.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43701875/81cdc4040867a551e8b2aa5b416df13f0d514521.gif[/img][/url]

We have decided to make systematic changes to the game, especially in the gameplay of store management, introducing many new systems. For example, the staff system: by managing and training store employees, you can increase the operational efficiency of your store. Of course, you'll also need to pay them, offer promotions, and salary raises. If they don't perform well, you can even dismiss them.

In short, the management gameplay will add more depth.

We hope to introduce the new playable version to you as soon as possible :)
